value.syntax: # [doc = " Shared JSON control-plane record written to stderr."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Serialize , Deserialize , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct ControlPlaneRecord { # [doc = " Record schema version."] pub schema : u32 , # [doc = " Binary or entrypoint name."] pub command : String , # [doc = " Machine-readable record kind."] pub kind : ControlPlaneRecordKind , # [doc = " Short human-readable message, still carried inside JSON."] pub message : String , # [doc = " Complete public argv bytes on usage failure, including values clap may abbreviate."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub arguments : Option < Vec < Vec < u8 > > > , # [doc = " Kind-specific structured fields."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub fields : Option < ControlPlaneFields > , }
